message.content:
I don’t have access to live clocks or real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now.  
If you need the precise time, you could:

1. **Check your device’s world clock** – most smartphones and computers let you add New York (or any other city) to a list of time zones.  
2. **Use a web service** – sites like [timeanddate.com](https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/) or the “world clock” feature on Google will show the current local time.  
3. **Ask a smart assistant** – Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa, etc., can give you the current time for a specified city.

If you’d like me to calculate sunrise or sunset times for New York on a particular date, just let me know!
